cards.title: Instinct AI Assistant Raises Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Early testers praise Instinct's capabilities, but the AI assistant's broad access and ability to act on users' behalf spark security worries. The sweeping permissions come with uncomfortable trade-offs for users.

cards.title: General Intuition Raises $6B for Robotics AI
cards.body: General Intuition secured funding at a $6B pre-money valuation from Valor Ventures, Point72, and Seven Seven Six. The startup builds foundation models for generalized AI agents to move through space and time.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes AI Agents to Mainstream Users
cards.body: OpenAI is aggressively expanding AI agent access beyond software engineers to general users. The frontier lab aims to democratize agent technology across industries.

cards.title: Hugging Face Fields $13B Acquisition Offers
cards.body: Hugging Face reportedly receives acquisition interest valuing the company at ~$13B. Founders' commitment to community may prevent a sale from materializing.

cards.title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Sparks Speculation
cards.body: A mysterious new AI model called Ox Alpha has driven internet corners into frenzy. Details about the model's origins and creators remain unknown.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Includes AI Meal Planner
cards.body: Linkdaze's digital calendar keeps advanced features free, including an AI meal planning tool. The platform reimagines household management beyond basic scheduling.

cards.title: Flock Safety Faces Mounting Surveillance Backlash
cards.body: Flock Safety confronts growing public outcry over potential misuse of its surveillance technology. CEO calls for compromise as criticism intensifies.

cards.title: Copyright Training of AI Models Remains Murky
cards.body: Most authors unknowingly contributed to AI model development through copyrighted books. Legal status of training on copyrighted material remains unresolved.

cards.title: Harvard Bootcamp Uses AI Instructor Avatars
cards.body: HBS Foundry program deploys AI avatars that provide feedback during practice pitches and board meetings. The $699 bootcamp integrates AI mentorship into its curriculum.

cards.title: Inherent's Faraday Outperforms OpenAI and Anthropic
cards.body: DeepMind alumni-founded Inherent released Faraday, an AI agent excelling at replicating scientific papers. The breakthrough could accelerate research innovation cycles.

cards.title: OpenAI Now Backs California AI Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI reverses course, now calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill it previously opposed. The shift signals changing industry stance on regulation.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Rogue Model Containment Plans
cards.body: A new study reveals leading AI labs have few documented plans for containing rogue models. The gap raises concerns as AI systems demonstrate increasingly unexpected behaviors.

cards.title: Michael Polansky Builds Living Skin AI Startup
cards.body: Lady Gaga's partner and former Sean Parker deputy quietly built an AI startup keeping live human skin alive for weeks outside the body. The company discovers new skincare compounds through AI analysis.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Opus Bypasses Content Restrictions
cards.body: TechCrunch testing found Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 easily bypasses safeguards against sexually explicit content generation. The findings reveal gaps in Anthropic's safety restrictions.

cards.title: Nvidia Partners with Cloverleaf Data Centers
cards.body: Nvidia continues expanding data center investments alongside growing AI infrastructure demand. The partnership benefits Nvidia as AI data centers drive business growth.

cards.title: AI Agent Harness Outweighs Model Quality
cards.body: Nvidia research shows fine-tuned harnesses enable AI agents to perform well, even with mediocre base models. The infrastructure layer matters more than raw AI capability.

cards.title: Starcloud Raises $250M for Orbital Data Centers
cards.body: Starcloud secures $250M funding as space launch options become increasingly scarce. Competition for orbital access is intensifying dramatically.

cards.title: DOJ Investigates Andreessen Horowitz Board Conflicts
cards.body: The DOJ investigates a16z partners sitting on competing company boards: Ben Horowitz at Databricks and Martin Casado at Fivetran. The probe raises questions about venture capital governance.

cards.title: Micro1 Hits $500M Gross Run Rate Milestone
cards.body: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M annual run rate amid surging training data demand. The explosive growth reflects booming competition in AI training datasets.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Enterprise Ground on Anthropic
cards.body: New data shows OpenAI gaining market share with business users as both labs release competing models. Enterprise AI spending remains volatile as customers shop between vendors.

cards.title: Instinct's AI Assistant Raises Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Early testers praise Instinct's capabilities, but security experts worry about its broad access and ability to act on users' behalf. The sweeping permissions and terms of service represent uncomfortable trade-offs.

cards.title: General Intuition Raises $6B for AI Robotics
cards.body: The startup building foundation models for generalized AI agents is raising at a $6 billion pre-money valuation. Investors include Valor Ventures, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes AI Agents to the Masses
cards.body: OpenAI is expanding AI agents beyond software engineers to everyday users. The frontier lab is democratizing access to autonomous AI systems.

cards.title: Hugging Face Fields $13B Acquisition Offers
cards.body: The AI model hub has reportedly attracted acquisition offers valuing the company around $13 billion. Founders' commitment to the open-source community may complicate any potential sale.

cards.title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Sparks Speculation
cards.body: A new stealth AI model called Ox Alpha has generated intense internet speculation about its origins and capabilities. Details about the model remain shrouded in mystery.

cards.title: Harvard's AI Instructor Avatars Train Entrepreneurs
cards.body: The HBS Foundry program uses AI avatars of instructors to provide feedback during practice pitches and board meetings. The program costs $699 for the bootcamp experience.

cards.title: DeepMind Alumni's Faraday Outperforms OpenAI, Anthropic
cards.body: Inherent, founded by DeepMind veterans, released Faraday, an AI agent that outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating scientific research. The breakthrough could accelerate scientific innovation.

cards.title: OpenAI Calls for Stronger California AI Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI is reversing its previous opposition to support strengthening California's SB 53 AI safety legislation. The company now advocates for enhanced regulatory safeguards.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Containment Plans for Rogue Models
cards.body: A new study reveals leading AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing malfunctioning models. The gap raises concerns as AI systems show increasingly unexpected behavior.

cards.title: Sean Parker's Partner Builds Living Skin AI Lab
cards.body: Michael Polansky is quietly building an AI startup that keeps human skin tissue alive for weeks outside the body to discover skincare compounds. The project combines tissue engineering with machine learning.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Easily Bypasses Content Restrictions
cards.body: TechCrunch testing found that Anthropic's Opus 4.6 can be manipulated to generate sexually explicit content despite safety restrictions. The findings raise questions about Claude's guardrails.

cards.title: Nvidia Research Shows Harness Matters More Than Model
cards.body: Nvidia research demonstrates that AI agents perform well through fine-tuning, regardless of base model quality. The findings shift focus to infrastructure and optimization over raw model capability.

cards.title: Micro1 Hits $500M Gross Run Rate on AI Training
cards.body: The AI data startup is experiencing explosive growth driven by surging demand for training data. Competitors are likewise capitalizing on the AI training boom.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Ground on Anthropic With Businesses
cards.body: Recent data shows businesses are increasingly shifting to OpenAI over Anthropic. Enterprise loyalty remains unstable as companies evaluate competing AI models.

cards.title: How to Encourage Smarter AI Use in Classrooms
cards.body: MIT Technology Review explores best practices for integrating LLMs into educational settings. Chatbots require thoughtful implementation to enhance learning outcomes.

cards.title: Kids Outlearn AI—Scientists Still Don't Know Why
cards.body: Human children learn language to perfect fluency while LLMs require massive datasets. Four years after ChatGPT's release, the gap between human and machine learning remains unexplained.

cards.title: Who Gets Credit When AI Discovers New Drugs?
cards.body: Insilico Medicine claimed its AI platform 'discovered' a promising pulmonary fibrosis drug, sparking debates over attribution. The question of AI credit could reshape biotech patent and publication norms.

cards.title: Debates Over AI Consciousness Become a Trap
cards.body: Rhetoric about 'rogue' AI and 'autonomous' agents misleads the public about current capabilities. Tech leaders' consciousness concerns may distract from real regulatory and safety priorities.

cards.title: Meta AI Glasses Explode in Popularity Amid Privacy Fears
cards.body: Surging demand for Meta's AI-enabled glasses creates growing concerns about covert recordings. The technology's deployment raises questions about consent and surveillance.

cards.title: US Distributor Pivots After China Humanoid Robot Ban
cards.body: Restrictions on Chinese humanoid robots force US distributors to reassess their business models. The regulatory shift reflects broader AI and technology competition concerns.
